paras: Ctenotus delli, also known commonly as the Darling Range south-west ctenotus or the Darling Range southwest ctenotus, is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Western Australia.
The specific name, delli, is in honor of Australian herpetologist John Dell.
C. delli is found in the south-west corner of the Australian state of Western Australia.
The preferred natural habitats of C. delli are forest and rocky areas.
Small for its genus, the average snout-to-vent length (SVL) of C. delli is 4.5 cm (1.8 in). The average tail length is about one and two thirds SVL.
C. delli is a member of the C. labillardieri species group.
